summary: KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc. filed an 8-K on Item 8.01 to announce a $9.04 per share dividend declared on June 30, 2026, payable on or about July 31, 2026 to holders of record on the declaration date. This is a routine capital return event that does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special-situation catalyst. The filing provides no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural complexity. As a standard dividend declaration by a BDC, it falls outside the enumerated special-situations categories.
